segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Last Saturday, my family and I went to the beach. We left home at eight o'clock in the morning. First, we drove to the beach. The drive took about one hour. After that, we parked the car and walked to the sand. The weather was sunny and hot. We put our things on the sand and went swimming. The water was cool and clean. Then we had a picnic lunch. I ate a sandwich and my sister ate a salad. After that, we played volleyball on the beach. My father took many photos. Finally, we watched the sunset. It was beautiful. We left the beach at six o'clock in the evening. On the way home, we stopped at a small restaurant. We ate dinner there. I had fish and my mother had chicken. The food was delicious. We arrived home at nine o'clock. We were very tired but happy. It was a great day. Next time, we want to visit a museum. My brother said, 'Let's go to the mountains next time.' But I said, 'No, I want to go to the museum.' So we will decide later. My sister wants to go to the zoo. We will see. Anyway, we had a wonderful time at the beach.
